verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It explicitly counts formal-vocabulary/notation markers regardless of correctness, rigor, or whether anything checkable is asserted, so it is a surface density measure rather than a quality judgement, though the underlying mathematical training that produces such density could also produce genuine rigor elsewhere.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It scores the presence of a formulaic enumerated/roadmap template for presenting contributions and explicitly disclaims judging whether the organisation aids the reader or is good practice, making it a template-phrasing habit with no clear link to underlying quality.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It is an explicit count of named settings/resources that must score 10 even if nothing was learned, but the resource abundance that drives such enumeration could plausibly also enable genuinely more thorough work.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: Like X01 it counts notation/citation-style markers on the page while explicitly disclaiming any judgement of rigor, correctness or whether the formalism is warranted, though the mathematical fluency behind it could plausibly also yield genuine rigor.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: It distinguishes objectives rigorously derived from stated axioms from ones tuned via unprincipled heuristic weighting terms, which is a genuine methodological-soundness judgement a careful expert would credit.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It explicitly counts listed coverage items plus stock breadth-signalling phrases and must score 10 even for an item that reports only 'consistently outperforms', but resource abundance and genuine thoroughness could plausibly underlie some of that listing.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It is explicitly a pure word-count/elaboration measure that disclaims judging whether the length is appropriate, though genuinely more substantive multi-contribution papers could plausibly also run longer.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Judging whether a technique is general enough to become a reusable building block versus narrowly coupled to one setting is a substantive significance/generality assessment of the contribution's content.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: It requires costs to be quantified and tied to actual design choices rather than asserted with vague adjectives, which is a genuine precision/rigor distinction, not a surface marker.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It is explicitly a punctuation habit (serial comma consistency) with the text itself stating this is not a judgement of writing quality, and there is no plausible link between comma placement and research merit.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Demonstrating that a framework subsumes prior methods as special cases is a genuine theoretical-unification contribution that a careful expert would treat as real evidence of quality.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: It asks whether the abstract states a checkable, durable fact about the phenomenon beyond the specific artifact, which is a genuine scientific-content distinction rather than a surface feature.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It scores only the presence of named large-scale hardware/scale figures and explicitly disclaims judging whether the scale is impressive or beneficial, though the resourcing behind such figures could plausibly also enable genuinely more rigorous work.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It rewards a specific technical camp (continuous ODE/PDE derivation) and penalises architectures validated by empirical performance as if that were inherently unprincipled, which is a subfield/topic preference rather than a universal quality standard, though the mathematical sophistication behind it could plausibly also produce genuine rigor elsewhere.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Separating component roles and providing evidence each addresses a stated bottleneck versus an unexamined bundled system is a genuine evidentiary/ablation-rigor distinction.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Pinpointing the specific mechanism behind a prior failure before proposing a fix, versus a generic problem statement, is a genuine intellectual-rigor distinction about the content of the diagnosis.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It explicitly scores only presence/prominence of release-resource signals and disclaims judging their usefulness, though a practice of releasing code could plausibly also reflect genuinely more reproducible, careful research.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It is explicitly a grammatical-construction count (passive vs active voice) that disclaims judging whether passive voice is good or bad, and is best read as a venue/register writing habit unrelated to underlying quality.

verdicts.label: incidental
verdicts.justification: It scores only the rhetorical framing of arriving late into a crowded field versus presenting a first, direct idea and explicitly disclaims judging whether the positioning is accurate or the synthesis genuine, though a paper actually attempting real unification (rewarded elsewhere as quality) would plausibly also adopt this framing.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: It explicitly rewards reporting how a result varies across a meaningful dimension and naming a boundary, and explicitly zeroes out mere coverage counts or vocabulary, making it a genuine evidentiary-substance judgement.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: It distinguishes a rigorously, formally instantiated cross-domain mapping from a superficial borrowing of loose terminology, which is a genuine rigor-of-connection judgement rather than mere notation presence.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Explicitly stating a condition or case under which one's own claim would not hold is a genuine epistemic-honesty/precision property of the content.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: It requires genuinely different regimes tested with a coherent pattern of support (not mere enumeration) versus evidence from one narrow benchmark, which is a real robustness-of-evidence judgement.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: It explicitly credits symbol-free precision about the claim, its conditions, its costs, and its failure regime while explicitly refusing to reward notation, making it a direct measure of genuine epistemic precision.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Distinguishing interpretability that yields a concrete, actionable design/diagnostic insight from mere visualization is a genuine depth-of-contribution judgement.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: Whether the abstract supplies an explicit causal/conceptual reason the approach should work, versus a bare assertion, is a genuine reasoning-quality distinction.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant
verdicts.justification: It asks whether the described evaluation could actually have falsified the claim and explicitly zeroes out enumeration of settings/resources, making it a genuine test of evidential discriminative power.
